input-field.name: activeProvider
input-field.label: Active provider
Aktiver Dienstleister
input-field.helpText: The courier integration this sales channel uses.

input-field.name: enableSandbox
input-field.label: Enable sandbox mode
Sandbox-Modus aktivieren
input-field.helpText: Use the provider's test environment. Disable before going live.

input-field.name: apiKey
input-field.label: Live API key
Live-API-Schlüssel
input-field.helpText: The active provider's live API key. Never share it publicly.

input-field.name: apiKeySandbox
input-field.label: Test API key
Test-API-Schlüssel
input-field.helpText: Used only while sandbox mode is enabled.

input-field.name: webhookSecret
input-field.label: Webhook signing secret
Webhook-Signatur-Geheimnis
input-field.helpText: Secret used to verify inbound tracking webhooks from the provider.

input-field.name: rateTimeoutSeconds
input-field.label: Rate request timeout (seconds)
Zeitlimit für Ratenabfrage (Sekunden)
input-field.helpText: How long to wait for live rates before using the flat-rate fallback.

input-field.name: flatRateFallback
input-field.label: Flat-rate fallback amount
Pauschaler Ausweichbetrag
input-field.helpText: Charged when the provider is slow or unavailable. In the sales channel currency.

input-field.name: rateMarkupPercent
input-field.label: Rate markup (%)
Aufschlag (%)
input-field.helpText: Percentage added to every live carrier rate before it is shown.

input-field.name: rateHandlingFee
input-field.label: Handling fee
Bearbeitungsgebühr
input-field.helpText: Flat amount added to every live rate, in the sales channel currency.

input-field.name: rateCacheTtlSeconds
input-field.label: Rate cache lifetime (seconds)
Cache-Dauer für Raten (Sekunden)
input-field.helpText: How long a quote set is reused before re-querying the provider.

input-field.name: enableDebugging
input-field.label: Enable debug logging
Debug-Protokollierung aktivieren
input-field.helpText: Writes debug, info and warning entries to var/log/kommandhub_shipping_*.log. Errors are always logged regardless of this setting. Can be scoped to a single sales channel.
Schreibt Debug-, Info- und Warnungseinträge nach var/log/kommandhub_shipping_*.log. Fehler werden unabhängig von dieser Einstellung immer protokolliert.

input-field.name: logLevels
input-field.label: Log levels
Protokollstufen
input-field.helpText: Restrict debug logging to specific PSR-3 levels. Leave empty to log every level once debug logging is enabled.
